## Definition
The spectral gap λ2(LG) of the lazy random walk Laplacian L=I−D⁻¹A, quantifying the mixing rate and connectivity robustness of the graph. Indicates how quickly information spreads across the wafer, directly impacting latency and load balancing in dynamic routing scenarios.
